evidence: unreadable: In seg2:end the '7% outside' label is tiny grey text on a grey floor, partly behind Data's legs. On a phone at arm's length it disappears.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: From seg2:start to seg2:end there are five near-identical hospital beds with bandaged patients. The headline changes to '93%', and a tiny '7% outside' sits beyond a red rope that Data is holding. Nothing in the picture separates the unvaccinated from the vaccinated or shows 93 against 7.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene puts the share in a caption and a barely visible label instead of in the beds themselves. The rope barrier never sorts anyone, so the picture claims nothing the headline does not already say.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the 93/7 split visible in the beds. Show a row of roughly 14 beds in which 13 patients have no vaccination mark and one has a clear vaccine-card or bandage marker, or have the rope physically divide a long row of beds from a single one. Data should do the sorting himself, for example wheeling each patient to their side of the rope as the count lands. Make the 7% label large text in ink colour, clear of Data.
